title: Waypoint storage bounds 32/256 and 5.03 waypoint_limit diagnostic (spec 18.3.2)
description: Spec 18.3.2: waypoint storage must be bounded at 32 entries per node, 256 globally. When full, return 5.03 Service Unavailable with waypoint_limit diagnostic. Current implementation has no bounds enforcement and no 5.03 response. Fix bounds + response code.
